# RepMaths

> Free, fast, ad-free fitness calculator suite — 25+ tools covering strength, training, nutrition, and body composition.

Last updated: 2026-10-11

## About

RepMaths is a free suite of fitness calculators, strength training generators, and nutrition planners. Designed for powerlifters, bodybuilders, athletes, and fitness enthusiasts. It provides evidence-based tools for workout programming, auto-regulation, body composition, and macronutrient tracking.

All calculators run client-side in the browser — no sign-up, no ads, no paywall.

## Key Tools & Calculators

### Strength & Powerlifting
- **1RM Calculator** — estimates one-rep max using Epley, Brzycki, Lander, or Lombardi formulas
- **Bench Press / Squat / Deadlift / Overhead Press Max Calculators** — lift-specific 1RM estimators
- **Rep Max Calculator** — converts known weight and reps to any target rep count
- **1RM Percentage Calculator** — finds training weight at any percentage of 1RM
- **Strength Standards Calculator** — compares 1RM to bodyweight-based reference standards

### Training & Programming
- **Training Max Calculator** — converts 1RM into a training max for 5/3/1 programs
- **5/3/1 Calculator** — generates the full Wendler 5/3/1 four-week cycle
- **Warm-Up Set Calculator** — builds a warm-up ramp from empty bar to working weight
- **RPE & RIR Calculator** — converts a completed set to an estimated 1RM using the RTS RPE chart

### Gym Math & Equipment
- **Barbell Plate Calculator** — determines plates to load on each side of the bar

### Nutrition & Body Composition
- **TDEE Calculator** — daily maintenance calories using Mifflin-St Jeor
- **BMR Calculator** — Basal Metabolic Rate using Mifflin-St Jeor or Harris-Benedict
- **Macro Calculator** — protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets for cutting, bulking, or maintenance
- **Protein Intake Calculator** — daily protein range based on ISSN sports nutrition guidance
- **Water Intake Calculator** — daily water target based on body weight and activity level
- **Calorie Deficit Calculator** — daily calorie deficit and estimated weight-loss timeline
- **Body Fat Calculator** — body fat percentage using the US Navy tape-measure method
- **BMI Calculator** — adult BMI, category, and BMI-based weight range
- **Lean Body Mass Calculator** — LBM from body fat percentage or predictive equations
- **FFMI Calculator** — fat-free mass index and normalized FFMI
- **Ideal Weight Calculator** — ideal body weight estimates and BMI-based healthy range
- **Calories Burned Calculator** — calories burned from activity using MET values

## How RepMaths is organized

RepMaths calculators are organized into four categories:

- [Strength calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/strength/) — 1RM, bench press, squat, deadlift, overhead press
- [Training calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/training/) — 5/3/1, training max, RPE/RIR, warm-up sets
- [Equipment calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/equipment/) — barbell plate loading
- [Nutrition calculators](https://repmaths.com/tools/nutrition/) — TDEE, BMR, macros, protein, body fat, BMI, FFMI

Full calculator directory: [All tools](https://repmaths.com/tools/)

## Content & Methodology

- Uses scientifically validated algorithms: Mifflin-St Jeor for BMR/TDEE, US Navy tape method for body fat, Epley/Brzycki/Lander/Lombardi for 1RM, Reactive Training Systems (RTS) RPE scale, ISSN protein guidelines, and MET values for calories burned.
- Core focus areas: CNS fatigue management, safe one-rep max determination, submaximal training, muscle hypertrophy, absolute strength programming, and sustainable body recomposition.
- Application design: ad-free, instant client-side calculation, mobile-first responsive architecture.

## Usage & Disclaimer

All content, tools, and generated calculations are provided for informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute medical advice. Users should consult a qualified healthcare or certified fitness professional before beginning any new rigorous training block or severe caloric diet regimen.
